notes:
## New features & enhancements

- If you have supported Markticulous on Ko-fi, the radio can now confirm it. Type the email you used on Ko-fi and click Check. Only a scrambled version of the email (a hash) is sent to markticulous.com, and only when you click Check. You can skip the check, as before.
- Once confirmed, Settings → Service shows "Supporter • verified ♥" under the thanks line.
- If you skipped the check, you can run it later from Confirm with Ko-fi in Settings → Service.
- The radio asks for support at most six times, at least 45 days apart. The option to stop asking for good appears from the third time.
- The supporter adornment's tooltip now reads "I supported Markticulous", because one Ko-fi supports every Markticulous app.
